messages:
maria: Anybody else seeing NCCL hangs on multi-gpu jobs after the kernel roll? Jobs hang on allreduce, no OOM, looks like inter-node only.
chris: which nodes/job ids?
maria: job=rl-train-42 node-a02 node-b11 node-b12
ashok: did we roll any infra kernel? last night we pushed 5.15.95 -> 5.15.100 to eu-west pool
maria: yep, nodes show new kernel. dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: QP 0x8b4 timed out, state=ERR
[ 1234.567892] ibv_cq_poll error: -110
```
maria: ibv_devinfo on node-a02:
```
link_layer: Ethernet
active_mtu: 9000
max_mtu: 4096
```
maria: on node-b11 active_mtu: 1500
devon: ah, MTU mismatch across path. likely fragmentation/drops for ROCE.
chris: can you paste `ethtool -S` for mlx5?
maria: ethtool shows rx_dropped due to 'rx_vlan_filter_fail'=312 and tx_xmit_more=0
ashok: short-term workaround: set NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 for the job to force TCP fallback. Better: align MTU across hosts (ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1500) or fix TOR config to 9000 everywhere.
chris: also check `bridge fdb`/vxlan offload. we've seen vxlan+offload flip mtu back to 1500 after kernel path change
maria: trying ip link set mtu 1500 on node-b11 now
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created: "eu-west rocev mtu mismatch -> NCCL hangs"
maria: after mtu change, job resumed progress. will schedule kernel rollback for next maintenance window and open a ticket to validate switch MTU across fabric
devon: cost note: long-term we should standardize on 9000 for perf, but need audit of TORs — pushing 100G/25G change is non-trivial; file in infra backlog
ashok: for root cause, suspect mlx5 firmware + kernel change changed offload behavior on vxlan. follow up: collect `tc qdisc show`, `ip -s link`, and switch config
maria: adding logs to INC-2026-042 and tagging network team. thanks all :thumbsup:
